answer: A proctored skill exam blocks bulk fakes. Each new identity passes one live exam task and pays a non-refundable 30-credit fee; the pass binds to its key and cannot be resold. Tasks use real work, such as planning an orchard harvest. Each script enters the shale archive for one epoch of peer re-grading; a confirmed proxy pass burns a 50-credit bond, defeating proxy test-taking. The k-th fake needs its own exam, fee, and pass, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 credits and 1,000 sittings, linear with no discount; an honest agent pays once; a lagoon of idle accounts earns nothing.
